command:
set -e
# The CI mutation job on every pull_request run of this branch: head, conclusion, duration.
# Exits non-zero if any finished job took 600 seconds or more, or none succeeded.
gh api 'repos/reijerteunis/seene/actions/runs?branch=claude/SEEN-116-property-and-mutation-gate&event=pull_request' --jq '.workflow_runs[].id' \
| while read id; do
  gh api "repos/reijerteunis/seene/actions/runs/$id/jobs" --jq '.jobs[]|select(.name|startswith("Incremental mutation"))|[.run_id,.head_sha[0:7],.conclusion,.started_at,.completed_at]|@tsv'
done | python3 -c '
import sys, datetime as d
p = lambda s: d.datetime.fromisoformat(s.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
rows = [l.split("\t") for l in sys.stdin.read().split("\n") if l]
ok = 0
for run, sha, concl, start, end in rows:
    secs = (p(end) - p(start)).total_seconds()
    print(f"run {run} head {sha} {concl} {secs:.0f}s")
    assert secs < 600, f"run {run} took {secs:.0f}s, over ten minutes"
    ok += concl == "success"
assert ok, "no successful mutation job on a pull_request run"
print(f"{ok} successful pull_request mutation job(s), every one under 600s")
'
data.output:
run 37070105397 head ca030d9 success 29s
run 37068194534 head 7682adc success 32s
2 successful pull_request mutation job(s), every one under 600s
